title: 금융위원회_주식시세정보
titleEnglish: Financial Services Commission — stock price information

licence.label: 이용허락범위 제한 없음
licence.attributionRequirements: No specific attribution condition is stated by the distribution’s unrestricted permission label or the linked portal policy for this distribution. No CC0, Apache-2.0 or KOGL type is inferred. Provider credit is retained under repository provenance rules.
licence.attribution: Source: Financial Services Commission (금융위원회), 금융위원회_주식시세정보, via data.go.kr. Trading date 2026-09-03; retrieved 2026-09-05 UTC (2026-09-06 KST).

venue.basis: The official getStockPriceInfo guide describes KRX-listed stocks and documents the mrktCls market filter. The request uses mrktCls=KOSPI; every returned mrktCtg is KOSPI. KRX-KOSPI is declared artifact metadata for that documented scope.

windowPolicy: First successful response satisfying the fixed completed date, 2–40 rows, single market and unique issue identities. Page 1 of 40 out of 943, not the whole market. No price-based filters or row selection. The portal states next-business-day publication after 13:00; 2026-09-03 is the latest trading date expected published before the weekend. Earlier local attempts failed the UTC verification-date precondition before any network request.

identity.constraint: Both identifiers are nonempty and unique within this one-date artifact; srtnCd is a publisher issue key, not an execution identifier.

derivation.itemValues: Complete string-valued items; no coercion, trimming, field filtering, sorting, normalization or financial arithmetic.
derivation.jsonlSerialization: Compact JSON.stringify(item) in response order; UTF-8 without BOM; LF between items and exactly one final LF.
derivation.generatedRowsSerialization: JSON.stringify(rows, null, 2) plus one final LF; coordinates contain JSONL SHA-256 and one-based physical line numbers.

interpretation.dateAnchor: basDt interpreted by explicit approval as YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00+09:00. The fixed Korean trading-date offset is a declared interpretation, not a publisher-returned timestamp or observed execution time.
interpretation.price: clpr is the daily closing price; requires a justified mapping override.
interpretation.quantity: trqu is the daily aggregate volume; requires a justified mapping override.
